transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metro line 6 links Tangzixiang with Airport Center station at the airport; the line has interchanges with lines 2, 3 and 4. Airport Center station is on Level B2 of the terminal.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: The taxi rank is opposite door 3 on Level B1. Trips to destinations within Kunming’s administrative boundaries are metered, with no surcharge for the empty return journey.
